summary: Iter-24 certification: (1) Marketplace funnel analytics [track-view + admin funnel], (2) EXDATE / cancel-single-occurrence for recurring live sessions, (3) HMAC-signed persistent ICS subscription URL, (4) Expanded test-hygiene cleanup patterns, (5) Cohort Enrollment (series=true) improvement. ALL 5 DELIVERABLES GREEN end-to-end. Backend: 523 passed / 3 skipped / 0 failures on full pytest regression (376s). All 23 new iter-24 tests (9 funnel + 14 exdate/subscription/cohort) PASS. Frontend: fixed one blocking CRA compile error in LiveSessionsPage.tsx (`import.meta.env.VITE_BACKEND_URL` → `(import.meta as any).env?.VITE_BACKEND_URL || process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL`), matching pattern used in sibling files. After fix: anonymous /catalog/1 fires POST /catalog/1/track-view (200) with no auth; admin /courses/1/edit shows funnel-panel with all 4 sub-testids (funnel-v-to-e, funnel-e-to-c, funnel-days-select, funnel-sparkline) + live data; admin /live-sessions shows subscribe-calendar-btn + cancel-{id} toggles + cancelled-badge-{id} + strikethrough on cancelled cards; learner /live-sessions shows subscribe-calendar-btn + BOTH rsvp-{id} single + rsvp-series-{id} buttons; clicking rsvp-series-* returned {status:'RSVP', series_count:3} with toast 'RSVP’d for the full series'; cancelled children hidden from learner view. Backend RCA bug found: view_to_enroll_rate and enroll_to_complete_rate are NOT clamped to [0.0, 1.0] as spec requires — when enrollments > views (common when tracking was added later on legacy courses) the UI displays 350% instead of 100%.

minor.issue: Rates NOT clamped to [0.0, 1.0] as spec requires. Course 1 shows views=2, enrollments=7 → view_to_enroll_rate=3.5 (UI renders 350.0%). Fix: wrap ratios with `min(1.0, ...)` in routers/marketplace_analytics.py lines 131-132. Existing pytest passes because autouse fixture wipes views for today AND test_admin_funnel_rates_are_bounded runs after test_admin_funnel_days_param_controls_window (which doesn't seed) so views=0 → safe-divide returns 0.0. Add an explicit test: seed 1 view + rely on historic 7 enrollments to verify clamp.

ui_bugs.issue: Used `import.meta.env.VITE_BACKEND_URL` in a CRA/Webpack project — TS2339 compile error blocked the ENTIRE frontend (compile-error overlay intercepted all pointer events across login, catalog, dashboard). Fixed by testing agent using `(import.meta as any).env?.VITE_BACKEND_URL || process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL || window.location.origin` (matches pattern in CourseEditPage.tsx and PublicCatalogPage.tsx). Recommend the main agent adopt a shared helper.

issues: View → Enrol shows 350.0% due to backend rate not being clamped (see backend minor issue above). UI itself renders correctly — bug is backend-side.

action_items: Clamp view_to_enroll_rate and enroll_to_complete_rate to [0.0, 1.0] in routers/marketplace_analytics.py (min(1.0, enrollments/views), min(1.0, completions/enrollments)). Real production data will regularly have enrollments > views because view-tracking was added in iter24 while enrollments are historical. Add a regression test that seeds 1 view + relies on historic enrollments and asserts rate == 1.0.

OPTIONAL: Extract the `(import.meta as any).env?.VITE_BACKEND_URL || process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL || ''` snippet into a shared `lib/env.ts` helper — currently duplicated in 3+ files and one of them (LiveSessionsPage.tsx) used the wrong pattern until this cert.
critical_code_review_comments: MARKETPLACE TRACK-VIEW — Backend verified: anonymous POST /api/catalog/1/track-view (no Authorization header) returns {tracked: true} 200 on first hit, {tracked: false, reason: 'already_counted_today'} on same-IP+UA repeat. Authed (learner) call generates distinct viewer_key='u:{id}' so it counts separately. Unknown course id returns 200 {tracked: false} (no existence leak). Frontend verified: /catalog/1 as anon fires POST via useEffect and network tab shows 200.

ADMIN FUNNEL — Backend verified: keys views/enrollments/completions/view_to_enroll_rate/enroll_to_complete_rate/daily/days_window/course_title present. days=7 returns daily length 8. Learner role → 403. Unknown course → 404. Daily arrays use func.date() (SQLite-safe). MINOR BUG: rates not clamped — see minor issue above.

ADMIN FUNNEL PANEL FRONTEND — /courses/1/edit right sidebar renders data-testid=funnel-panel with 3 stat cards, 2 rate rows (funnel-v-to-e, funnel-e-to-c), funnel-days-select dropdown (7/30/90), and funnel-sparkline SVG. Days selector triggers re-fetch with correct ?days= query.

LIVE SESSIONS EXDATE — Backend verified: POST /:id/cancel stamps cancelled_at (200), row still exists via admin GET but hidden from learner /upcoming. POST /:id/uncancel restores. Cancelling one child does NOT touch head or siblings. Head .ics body contains both `RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;COUNT=4` and `EXDATE:` line for cancelled child.

REMINDER WORKER — Direct-DB test verified: LiveSession with start_at=now+15m + active RSVP + cancelled_at IS NOT NULL → tick() produces 0 new outbox rows (assert after == before). filter(LiveSession.cancelled_at.is_(None)) confirmed in worker source.

SUBSCRIPTION URL — Backend verified: POST /live-sessions/subscribe-url?kind=admin returns {token, path}; path starts /api/live-sessions/subscribe/ ends .ics. Learner kind=admin → 403. Learner kind=learner → 200. GET subscribe/{token}.ics from FRESH anonymous requests.Session (no cookies, no headers) returns text/calendar with BEGIN:VCALENDAR envelope containing VEVENT blocks for our test series (iter24-exdate-series). Bad token → 401. Tampered signature byte → 401. Same user+kind → same token (HMAC deterministic on JWT_SECRET).

COHORT ENROLLMENT — Backend verified: POST /:head/rsvp?series=true → {status:'RSVP', series_count:3}. Second call → {status:'CANCELLED'} for all 3. Non-series (standalone) session ?series=true → 400 with 'series' in message body ({error:{message:'...series...'}} shape). Cancelled middle child SKIPPED — series_count becomes 2 (head + last non-cancelled child) not 3. Frontend verified: learner clicked rsvp-series-1, network tab showed {status:'RSVP', series_count:3, my_rsvp_status:'RSVP'}; toast reads 'RSVP’d for the full series (3 sessions)'.

LIVE SESSIONS UI — Admin: subscribe-calendar-btn + cancel-{id} + cancelled-badge-{id} + strikethrough on cancelled title all present and functional. Learner: subscribe-calendar-btn + rsvp-{id} + rsvp-series-{id} present; cancelled sessions correctly HIDDEN from learner listing (verified: middle cancel-skip child not in learner view but visible to admin).

TEST DEBRIS CLEANUP — services/test_debris_cleanup.py verified via 5-key dict return {courses, live_sessions, terms_versions, outbox_messages, course_views}: idempotent second-tick returns all zeros. LIVE_SESSION_TITLE_PATTERNS now covers iter24-* (I verified by seeing 6 leftover iter24-cohort-* sessions from broken teardowns which I cleaned manually — the CLI would have caught them). course_views cleanup uses viewed_on_date < today-90d threshold.
AUTH POSTURE — Anon track-view uses get_optional_user dep that returns None instead of raising 401. Verified via anonymous requests.Session (no cookies, no Authorization).

TEARDOWN — Cleaned 6 residual iter24-cohort-enrol-series/iter24-cohort-cancel-skip LiveSessions + their RSVPs after tests (some `finally: delete` blocks appear to have been interrupted). CourseViews for today = 0. Admin 2FA state untouched. Marketplace_opt_in preserved. No stray is_current=True TermsVersions created.

rca of the issue: FRONTEND COMPILE BLOCKER: LiveSessionsPage.tsx used `import.meta.env.VITE_BACKEND_URL` which is a Vite-specific API. This project uses Create React App (webpack) — confirmed by presence of WDS_SOCKET_PORT env var, `process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL` throughout, and package.json using react-scripts. Sibling files (CourseEditPage.tsx, PublicCatalogPage.tsx) correctly cast `(import.meta as any).env?.VITE_BACKEND_URL || process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL`. Fix: matched sibling pattern, one-line edit at line 97. Verified: webpack overlay gone, /login functional, all downstream tests pass. BACKEND UNCLAMPED RATES: routers/marketplace_analytics.py lines 131-132 compute `enrollments / views` and `completions / enrollments` with only a safe-divide guard but no upper bound. Tests pass because autouse fixture wipes views before each test and the boundedness test happens to run when views=0 (safe-divide returns 0.0). In production, views started being tracked in iter24 while enrollments have historic backlog → ratio > 1. Fix: wrap both with min(1.0, ...).
